propositions: Jira-family-general units currently in adapters/jira/ must be extracted to a new adapters/jira_family/ package with public names and no re-export shims

identity.py relocates whole; probe.py's classifier relocates taking resolved-status set as required keyword-only parameter; jira_fields.py splits by symbol with sanitizers contract-parameterized and maps unified to single definition site
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) remain in-place and import from jira_family/ by dependency inversion, with no file moves or _loader.py edits
The unified status map adopts deleted→Done matching outbound_fields and config.py, fixing a latent bug where ACLI path emitted invalid Deleted state
All internal importers and mock.patch strings must be re-pointed to new jira_family paths with absolute imports (never relative) verified against spec_from_file_location load mode
Import contract is enforced as a persistent AST-walking test asserting acyclic graph: no module outside jira/* imports jira_family/; jira_family/ imports neither jira/ nor jira_datacenter/
